  (U : Ω → Δ),
  (∀ (ω ω' : Ω), Z ω = Z ω' → U ω = U ω') →
    ∀ (E S : Ω → Prop) (B : Γ → Prop),
      (∀ (ω ω' : Ω), Z ω = Z ω' → (S ω ↔ S ω')) →

                    S ω → B (Z ω) → (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P E fun (v : Ω) => Z v = Z ω) ≤ b) →
                ∀ (u : Δ),
                  (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) →
                    (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (ω : Ω) => E ω ∧ S ω) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) ≤

                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileWords cuts p ω j) →

                                              RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),

name: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.residual_product_upper_uniform
type:
∀ (g τ T : ℝ),
  0 < g →
    g < 1 →
      0 < τ →
        τ < g →
          0 < T →
            Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) < 1 →
              ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                1 ≤ N0 ∧
                  ∀ (n : ℕ),
                    N0 ≤ n →
                      ∀ (c m : ℕ),
                        g * ↑n ≤ ↑c →
                          m ≤ 2 →
                            ∀ (ι : Type u_1) (J : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (R : ι → ℕ),
                              ↑J.card ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                (∀ j ∈ J, 0 ≤ p j ∧ p j ≤ 1) →
                                  (∀ j ∈ J, R j ≤ c + m) →
                                    (∀ j ∈ J, ↑(R j) ≤ ↑n * p j) →
                                      (∀ j ∈ J, |↑(R j) - ↑c * p j| ≤ ↑n ^ (2 / 3) + ↑m) →
                                        ∏ j ∈ J, RiffleLowerV2.falling (R j) m / RiffleLowerV2.falling (c + m) m ≤
                                          2 ^ m * (∏ j ∈ J, p j) ^ (↑m * (1 - Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ)))

name: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.reserve_tailWeight_finite
type:
∀ {k n L D : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)),
  0 < n →
    0 < k →
      1 ≤ D →
        ∀ (g ξ : ℝ),
          0 < g →
            ∀ (p : Fin k) (M : Finset (Fin n)) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
              (∀ r ∈ M, List.Vector.get (RiffleUpperV2.rowWord ω r) 0 = p) →
                M.card = 1 ∨ M.card = 2 →
                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g ξ ω →
                    ∀ (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min D L)),
                      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.reserveMass k D g ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailMass cuts D v →
                        1 ≤ n - RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p →
                          ↑n ^ (2 / 3) + 5 ≤
                              ↑(n - RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) * (1 / (4 * ↑D)) *
                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.reserveMass k D g →
                            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.reserveMass k D g ^ M.card / 2 ≤
                              ∏ r : Fin (min D L),
                                RiffleLowerV2.falling
                                    (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.remainingCount p M ⟨↑r + 1, ⋯⟩ (List.Vector.get v r) ω)
                                    M.card /
                                  RiffleLowerV2.falling (n - RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p + M.card) M.card

  RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileBase cuts p e A a ω₀ →
    ∀
      (v :
        Lex (RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min D L) × Lex (RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min D L) × RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min D L)))),
      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.chosenReserves cuts D g = some v →
        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward
            (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileWords cuts p ω j) →
          RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.unmarkedHistoryConstraint cuts p ω j A a →
            ∏ r : Fin (min D L),
                RiffleLowerV2.falling
                    (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.remainingCount p (Finset.map e (Finset.univ \ A)) ⟨↑r + 1, ⋯⟩
                      (List.Vector.get v.2.2 r) ω₀)
                    (Finset.univ \ A).card /
                  RiffleLowerV2.falling (n - RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p + (Finset.univ \ A).card)

              RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)

  (a : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) (ω₀ : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  (∀ q ∈ A, RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords e ω₀ q = a q) →
    ∀ (F : (Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) → ℝ),
      (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
          (fun (v : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => F (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords e v))
          fun (v : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
          (∀ (q : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
              List.Vector.get (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords e v q) 0 = p) ∧
            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward (↑j + 1) ω v ∧
              ∀ q ∈ A, RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords e v q = a q) =
        (∑ w : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1),
            if RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleHistoryConstraint cuts p ω j w ∧ ∀ q ∈ A, w q = a q then
              RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.residualTupleWeight cuts A a w * F w
            else 0) /
          ∑ w : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1),
            if RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleHistoryConstraint cuts p ω j w ∧ ∀ q ∈ A, w q = a q then

name: RiffleUpperV2.Localization.smallDensity_of_expected_edges
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) {μ tail : ℝ},
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) → ∑ i ∈ s, p i ≤ μ ^ 2 * tail / 2 → ∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 ≤ μ ^ 4 * tail ^ 2 / 4

name: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.falling_ratio_lower_one_two
type:
∀ {M R m : ℕ},
  2 ≤ M →
    m = 1 ∨ m = 2 → ∀ {q : ℝ}, 0 ≤ q → ↑M * q + 1 ≤ ↑R → q ^ m ≤ RiffleLowerV2.falling R m / RiffleLowerV2.falling M m

name: RiffleUpperV2.Localization.prefix_card_bound

name: RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.largeExponent_core
type:
∀ {ell V F E H S Q beta B D theta delta q eH : ℝ},
  theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4 →
    0 ≤ delta →
      0 ≤ q →
        ell = V - S - Q →
          0 ≤ Q →
            ell - F ≤ delta →
              V - q ≤ 2 * F →
                V ≤ beta →
                  H ≤ theta * S - B + eH →
                    E = -D → H + 4 * ell - F + 2 * E ≤ (theta + 3) / 2 * beta - B - 2 * D + delta + q / 2 + eH
